rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone complies without protesting.

example.english: I compliantly handed over my phone without saying a word.
example.traditional: 我冇出聲，乖乖咁交低部手機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 ceot1 seng1 gwaai1 gwaai1 gam3 gaau1 dai1 bou6 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on obeying instructions or behaving obediently, especially for a child or subordinate.

example.english: The child compliantly followed the teacher's instructions.
example.traditional: 個細路聽話咁跟住老師嘅指示做。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 teng1 waa6 gam3 gan1 zyu6 lou5 si1 ge3 zi2 si6 zou6
